description: A candlelit wooden courtroom with a man in a black coat and grey wig gesturing toward a bench, with a paper in one hand. Two rows of soldiers in red coats sit on benches at left and right, heads bowed. Townspeople in dark 18th-century clothes sit or stand in the crowd behind, and two wigged judges sit at the upper right beside a window. No visible text, frame or border; the painting fills the image edge to edge.
